name: Luxual Hellmare
original_name: ラグジュアル・ヘルマーレ
source: A first year student at Evil Rayatt Girls Academy (A demon girl academy) who met the [url=/c94631]protagonist[/url] when she went on a friendship exchange quest with Farench Deshka Girls Academy. Her personality is bit much; she is confident and hates to lose. She has a fledgling level of magical power, but she is quite flashy because of her chuunibyo disorder.  However, she also shows her girlish side where it counts, such as fixing the protagonist's clothes if they are dirty or unorderly.
